text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the academy, I spotted Marvelous Sunday 
being thanked by a student.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Marvel-chan! Thanks to 
your 
marvelous advice, my room makeover turned 
out 
absolutely marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelooous☆ 
If anything else is troubling you, just 
say the word!★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Lucky you, Marvel-chan.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Are you troubled too, Mayano? Go on, lay 
it on me☆ 
I'll share some marvelous with you!★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not that. It's just... solving 
people's problems 
feels so totally grown-up! 
Maya kinda wants to try doing it too~

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you can do that right now, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
After all—just like I've got my 
"Marvelous!", 
you've got your "Got it!", don't you?☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! Whoaaa~~~ you're totally 
right!!
choice_data_list:
(...Are those two concepts even remotely 
on the same level?)

(...Are those two concepts even remotely 
on the same level?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And thus, Mayano Top Gun's Consultation 
Booth 
officially opened for business.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So, about the welcome party for the new 
girls... 
Are there any, like, super stylish places 
around?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
! Maya's got it! 
This place right here! I just know they'll 
love it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Man, they were thrilled to death! 
Maya-chan, your taste is unreal!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Behold, this is my father's next opponent. 
Word is he's an amateur wrestling 
champion— 
what strategy ought he employ, dost thou 
think?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Got it! How about he challenges the guy 
using the opponent's own signature move?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha! The belly-to-back suplex landed 
with glorious perfection! 
To see right through the champion's 
haughty overconfidence... 
Thou art truly remarkable!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, it's been raining non-stop, so the 
park's totally deserted... 
I can't play with anyone, and it's so 
lonely...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Got it! 
Here's what you do—go help out 
in the cafeteria during lunch!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I made great friends with the cafeteria 
ladies! 
And they even gave me treats for helping 
out! So happy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I lost my temper at Vodka again... 
I was thinking of giving her an apology 
gift, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Got it! In that case... 
A brush! A nice, big one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-A brush? Are you sure... 
something like that will work...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Vodka was ecstatic. 
Said she'd use it to maintain her leather 
jacket... 
Mayano, did you know that from the start?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Nope! Back then, um... 
It was just a hunch, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Pure intuition, huh. 
You really are incredible...

text_block_list.name: Frightened Inquirer
text_block_list.text:
—Lately, I've been hearing weird noises in 
the dorms at night. 
Heavy breathing, like someone drooling and 
slurping... 
I've been so terrified I can barely 
sleep...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Yup! Maya's totally got it! 
Go set up a carrot trap out in the 
hallway!

text_block_list.name: Frightened Inquirer
text_block_list.text:
A-A carrot...? W-Well... I guess I can 
try...

text_block_list.name: Frightened Inquirer
text_block_list.text:
It worked, Mayano-chan! 
Turns out someone was just so starving 
they kept sneaking 
down to raid the kitchen in the middle of 
the night—

text_block_list.name: Astonished Students
text_block_list.text:
"I-Incredible!" 
"She really has an answer for everything!"

text_block_list.name: Flocking Students
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please, hear my troubles next...!" 
"Ooooh, praise be, praise be...!" 
"Lady Mayano, please guide us!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Did Maya get a little closer 
to being a dependable, mature woman?~♪
choice_data_list:
(I don't think "mature" is quite the word 
for this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Go to "Lady Mayano," and your troubles 
will vanish. 
This craze swept through the academy 
for quite some time—
